# Lens: Product

Does every behaviour trace to the request and its acceptance items? Is anything built that nobody asked for, or asked for and left out? Is the smallest version that meets the items the one specified?

Severities (design): CRITICAL = the design cannot be built or would break shipped behaviour; HIGH = a likely defect or an unmet acceptance item; MEDIUM = a gap a builder would have to guess at; LOW = wording or polish.
